definition_en: The ability to understand and act on responsibilities toward broader society, including ethical behaviour, diversity and inclusion, and awareness of global interdependencies.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami dan bertindak atas tanggungjawab terhadap masyarakat luas, termasuk tingkah laku beretika, kepelbagaian dan keterangkuman, serta kesedaran tentang saling kebergantungan global.
typical_tasks_en:
• Review a supplier contract for ethical labour practices.
• Advocate for a more inclusive hiring process for women returning to work.
• Adapt a campaign for audiences across Malaysia, Indonesia, and Singapore.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Semak kontrak pembekal untuk amalan buruh beretika.
• Advokasi proses pengambilan pekerja yang lebih inklusif untuk wanita kembali bekerja.
• Sesuaikan kempen untuk audiens merentasi Malaysia, Indonesia dan Singapura.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires considering ethical implications of decisions
• The task involves promoting diversity, equity, or inclusion
• The task requires understanding global or cultural contexts
• The task involves social responsibility or community engagement
• The task requires navigating ethical dilemmas or conflicts of interest
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves purely technical execution with no ethical dimension
• The user performs work without considering broader social impact
• The task requires no awareness of diversity or global context
• The user is following orders without questioning ethical implications
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task is purely technical or administrative with no ethical, diversity, or social dimension.

confusions.boundary_rule: Global citizenship is broad social/ethical responsibility. Environmental stewardship is specifically environmental.
confusions.example_task: Promote both recycling and fair labour practices across the supply chain.

confusions.boundary_rule: Global citizenship involves ethical action. Empathy is interpersonal understanding.
confusions.example_task: Understand diverse employee backgrounds and advocate for inclusive policies.
confusions.expected_labels: Global citizenship; Empathy and active listening

confusions.boundary_rule: Global citizenship is about values. Leadership is about direction.
confusions.example_task: Lead the team to adopt ethical sourcing practices.
confusions.expected_labels: Leadership and social influence; Global citizenship
